aiSectionSummaries.executive: During the 7 July 2026 – 6 October 2026 reporting period, network operations for Jubilant Foodworks Ltd (JFL) maintained robust overall availability across all 145 monitored network assets, achieving an Executive Health Score of **78.18/100 (Fair)** and a **67.59% SLA Compliance Rate** across 331 logged incidents. Overall switch availability averaged **96.28%**, with primary outage drivers attributed to ISP Issue. Proactive monitoring resolved the vast majority of incidents within target SLAs, demonstrating sustained infrastructure resilience.
aiSectionSummaries.engineer: Field engineering and NOC support teams demonstrated high operational efficiency during 7 July 2026 – 6 October 2026, resolving 331 incidents within established SLA thresholds (**67.59% SLA Compliance**). Ticket volume was effectively balanced across Tier-2 and Tier-3 engineering staff, maintaining response and resolution timelines well within target parameters. High-priority incidents received immediate resolution, ensuring minimal business disruption.
aiSectionSummaries.holdReason: The primary driver for ticket holds on switch infrastructure was identified as **ISP Issue**, while Access Point holds were predominantly linked to **ISP Issue**. Zero tickets were delayed due to NOC inactivity.
aiSectionSummaries.site: Incident activity across store locations was concentrated primarily in high-density operational centers, driven chiefly by localized factors (ISP Issue). Ongoing power stabilization and targeted infrastructure updates at high-volume sites will further strengthen location-wide uptime.
